services.name: Complete Construction
services.line: Residential and commercial building from site preparation to handover.
services.who: Owners and developers who want one accountable team for the whole build, from a plot to a finished building.
problems: Splitting a build between several contractors with unclear responsibility
Grey structure and finishing that do not meet each other cleanly
Building services planned too late to fit the design
deliver: A defined scope of work for your appointment
inputs: Plot or site details and ownership documents
Approved drawings, or a brief we can develop into them
Budget range or a request for guidance
faqs: Do you only build full turnkey projects?
Turnkey scope is defined per appointment. Some clients engage us for structure only or for finishing only.
Is structural design included?
Structural and building-services design are coordinated with appropriate specialist review rather than assumed.
Do you work on commercial buildings?
Yes. Residential and commercial projects are both in scope, with the appointment defining exactly what is included.

services.name: Interior Design & Fit-out
services.line: Layouts, concepts, ceilings, lighting, joinery and fit-out coordination.
services.who: Homeowners and businesses furnishing a new or existing space who want a considered, coordinated result.
problems: A layout that does not match how the space is used
Lighting and ceiling decisions made after the electrics
Joinery, curtains and furniture that never quite agree
inputs: Plans or measurements of the space
faqs: Can you design without building?
Yes. Design and documentation can be commissioned separately from fit-out.
Is design development the same as a visualisation?
No. Design development resolves layout, materials and details. A visualisation shows a design that already exists. See 3D Visualisation.
Do you handle commercial interiors?
Yes. Shops, cafés and offices are designed and coordinated in the same way as homes, with layouts for how the space trades or works.

services.name: Renovation & Remodelling
services.line: From a single room to a full property, with phased work where needed.
services.who: Owners of existing homes and premises who need to repair, reorganise or update without starting over.
problems: Not knowing what can be kept, repaired or removed
Living or trading through the work
Surprises behind walls and under floors
faqs: Can we stay in the property during works?
Often, with phasing. It depends on the scope and which services are affected.
Can you work from photos alone?
Photos help with early discussion. A site visit and measurement are needed before any scope is fixed.

services.name: Drawings & Documentation
services.line: Plans, elevations, sections, ceiling and lighting layouts, joinery and construction details.
services.who: Owners, contractors and designers who need clear information to build, price or approve from.
problems: Verbal instructions that different trades read differently
Prices that cannot be compared because drawings are incomplete
Services drawn separately from the architecture
scope: Structural and MEP coordination with specialist review
deliver: Drawing set to the agreed scope
faqs: Are these structural drawings?
Architectural and interior documentation is ours. Structural and MEP drawings need review by the relevant specialists.
Can I use these for approvals?
Approval requirements vary by authority. We will confirm what each submission needs when the scope is set.

services.name: Estimation & BOQs
services.line: Quantity take-offs, itemised scope, budget planning and specifications.
services.who: Owners and contractors who want to know what a project involves before committing.
problems: Budgets set without quantities behind them
Quotes that cannot be compared line by line
Specifications that leave room for substitution
scope: Specifications and vendor or material comparison
inputs: Location, since rates depend on it
faqs: Can you price from a photo?
No. An estimate needs measured quantities and a defined scope. Photos only help frame the conversation.
Do you publish rates?
No. Rates change, so figures are prepared for your project with their date and basis stated.

services.name: Project Consultancy
services.line: Feasibility, review, contractor coordination and site supervision under an agreed scope.
services.who: Owners who already have a design or a contractor and want independent, practical oversight.
problems: Not knowing whether a plan is feasible before spending on it
Contractor claims you cannot verify
Progress that drifts from the drawings
inputs: Contract or quote if one exists
faqs: Is consultancy only for projects you build?
No. It is offered on its own, under a scope we agree beforehand.

services.name: 3D Visualisation & Walkthroughs
services.line: Photorealistic still renders, 3D modelling for visualisation and animated walkthroughs.
services.who: Architects, designers, developers and owners who need to see a design before it is built. Bring your own drawings or model, or commission design and visualisation together.
problems: Approving a design from plans that are hard to read
Presenting to partners or buyers before construction
Comparing material and lighting options early
deliver: Still images at an agreed resolution
Walkthrough film at an agreed length
Source files and formats as agreed
faqs: Can I commission visualisation only?
Yes. It is a standalone service as well as part of design and build.
How long and how much?
Views, resolution, animation length, source drawings, revisions and output formats are agreed per project, so we do not publish fixed times or fees.
Is a render engineering documentation?
No. A render shows a design. It does not replace drawings or specialist engineering.
Is a slideshow a walkthrough?
No. A walkthrough is an animation through a 3D model, and we label any other format for what it is.
Do you offer 360 or VR tours?
Not as an advertised service at present. Ask us if your project needs one.
services.note: Views, image resolution, animation length, source models and drawings, revisions and output formats are agreed for each project. We visualise your own design as a standalone commission, or the design we develop with you. A render or walkthrough shows a design; it is not engineering documentation.

projects.title: Hillside Villa
projects.summary: A two-storey family home with a cantilevered upper floor, a stone stair core and a pool terrace. Developed as a concept study to show the full path from massing to lines, lit renders and a navigable 3D model.
projects.challenge: Give a family living space that opens fully to the garden while staying shaded and private, and let the owner understand the design before construction.
projects.scope: Massing study, elevation linework, exterior and interior concept renders (living, kitchen, bedroom), a real-time 3D model with facade and light options, and a camera tour through the model.
decisions: The upper floor cantilevers over the terrace, shading the living-room glazing at midday.
Full-height sliding glazing joins living and dining to the pool deck.
Vertical timber fins screen the upper bedroom from low western sun.
A stone-clad stair core anchors the composition and holds vertical services.
materials: White plaster or exposed concrete (both shown in the 3D model)

projects.title: Neighbourhood Café
projects.summary: A daylit café fit-out with a deep navy service counter, exposed timber beams and a row of pendants that leads customers from the door to the order point.
projects.challenge: Make a narrow commercial unit feel generous, keep the queue clear of seating, and give staff a working counter with storage.
projects.scope: Layout, ceiling and lighting concept, counter and shelving joinery intent, finishes palette and a concept render.
decisions: The counter runs along the back wall so the queue never crosses the seating.
Exposed beams lower the perceived ceiling over tables for a calmer seated zone.
Pendants line up over the counter to guide customers.
Two-top tables can be pushed together for groups.
materials: Painted counter front with stone-effect top

media.caption: Seating and counter. Concept render.

projects.title: Primary Bedroom Refresh
projects.summary: A renovation concept that keeps the window, flooring and room footprint, and changes the feel with a deep green feature wall, a cove ceiling and a timber headboard.
projects.challenge: Refresh a bedroom without moving windows or replacing the floor, so the work is quick and the room is usable sooner.
projects.scope: Retain-and-change review, lighting and ceiling concept, feature wall and headboard design, concept render.
decisions: Window, floor and footprint are retained to keep the work light.
A cove ceiling gives soft indirect light and hides new wiring.
A deep green wall behind the bed gives a calm focal point.
A timber headboard adds warmth without new furniture clutter.
materials: Gypsum board cove with LED strip

media.caption: Refreshed bedroom. Concept render.
